classification.difficultyReason: Recognise even and odd powers from the shapes of supplied graphs.

content.prompt: The graph of $y=x^n$ is given. State whether the power is even or odd.

spec.description: Increasing S-shaped power curve through the origin, with arrows at both ends; unnumbered axes have arrows at both ends and x and y labels.
spec.mathematics: Odd-power qualitative shape. A cubic representative reconstructs the visible shape; no exponent or coordinate scale is supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Curve is a permanent question given; parity response belongs only in answers.

answer.worked: Odd: the curve has an inflection point and its ends extend in opposite directions.

spec.description: Upward-opening curve symmetric about the y-axis, with a flat bottom at the origin and arrows at both ends; no ticks or grid.
spec.mathematics: Even-power qualitative shape, flatter at the origin than graph c. A quartic representative is used without supplying an exponent or numerical scale.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent supplied curve; parity response is answer-only.

answer.worked: Even: the curve has a turning point and is symmetric about the $y$-axis.
